questions.question: What are the core working hours?
questions.answer: Core working hours are 11:00 to 16:00 India Standard Time [S1].

questions.question: How many days of paid annual leave do full-time employees get?
questions.answer: Full-time employees receive 24 days of paid annual leave per calendar year [S1].

questions.question: How many unused leave days can I carry over to the next year?
questions.answer: Up to 6 unused leave days can be carried over to the next year [S1].

questions.question: When do carried-over leave days expire?
questions.answer: Carried-over leave days expire on 31 March [S1].

questions.question: When do I need a medical certificate for sick leave?
questions.answer: A medical certificate is required for sick leave absences longer than 2 consecutive days [S1].

questions.question: How many days a week am I allowed to work from home?
questions.answer: You are allowed to work remotely up to 3 days per week [S1].

questions.question: Who has to approve a fully remote work arrangement?
questions.answer: A fully remote work arrangement needs written approval from both the team lead and the HR department [S1].

questions.question: How much is the home office allowance for remote employees?
questions.answer: Remote employees receive a one-time home office allowance of INR 15,000 [S1].

questions.question: What is the deadline for submitting travel expense claims?
questions.answer: Travel expenses must be submitted within 30 days of the trip [S1].

questions.question: What is the daily limit for meal reimbursement during business travel?
questions.answer: Meals during business travel are reimbursed up to INR 1,500 per day [S2].

questions.question: How large is the yearly learning budget per employee?
questions.answer: Each employee has an annual learning budget of INR 40,000 [S1].

questions.question: What is the minimum password length for company accounts?
questions.answer: The minimum password length for company accounts is 14 characters [S1].

questions.question: Which systems require multi-factor authentication?
questions.answer: Multi-factor authentication is mandatory for email, source code hosting, and the cloud console [S1].

questions.question: Who is given hardware security keys?
questions.answer: Hardware security keys are issued to administrators [S1].

questions.question: After how many minutes of inactivity must a company laptop lock?
questions.answer: A company laptop must lock after 5 minutes of inactivity [S1].

questions.question: Am I allowed to copy customer data to a USB drive?
questions.answer: No, copying customer data to personal devices or USB drives is prohibited [S1].

questions.question: How soon must a lost or stolen laptop be reported?
questions.answer: A lost or stolen device must be reported to it-security@northwind.example within 1 hour of discovering the loss [S1].

questions.question: How quickly must the on-call security engineer respond to a P1 security incident?
questions.answer: The on-call security engineer must respond to a P1 security incident within 15 minutes [S1].

questions.question: When is the written report for a P1 security incident due?
questions.answer: A written incident report for a P1 security incident is due within 48 hours [S1].

questions.question: How should I report a phishing email?
questions.answer: Phishing emails should be reported using the Report Phishing button and must not be forwarded to colleagues [S1].

questions.question: Who is covered by the group health insurance?
questions.answer: Group health insurance covers the employee, their spouse, and up to two children [S1].

questions.question: What is the sum insured under the health insurance policy?
questions.answer: The sum insured is INR 5,00,000 per family per year [S1].

questions.question: How long do new joiners have to enrol in health insurance?
questions.answer: New employees must enrol within 30 days of joining [S1].

questions.question: How much paid parental leave do primary caregivers get?
questions.answer: Primary caregivers receive 26 weeks of fully paid parental leave [S1].

questions.question: How long is paternity leave for a secondary caregiver?
questions.answer: Secondary caregivers receive 4 weeks of paid leave [S1].

questions.question: How much can I claim each year for a gym membership?
questions.answer: Each employee can claim up to INR 12,000 per year for wellness expenses such as gym memberships [S1].

questions.question: How much does the company contribute to the provident fund?
questions.answer: Northwind contributes 12% of basic salary to the provident fund [S1].

questions.question: After how many years of service is gratuity paid?
questions.answer: Gratuity is paid after 5 years of continuous service [S1].

questions.question: When do new employees get their laptop?
questions.answer: New employees receive their laptop on their first working day [S1].

questions.question: How often are laptops replaced?
questions.answer: Laptops are replaced every 3 years [S1].

questions.question: What is the name of the company VPN client?
questions.answer: The name of the company VPN client is NorthGate [S1].

questions.question: What is the staff Wi-Fi network called?
questions.answer: The staff Wi-Fi network is called NW-Staff [S1].

questions.question: How quickly does IT respond when there is a complete IT outage?
questions.answer: When there is a complete IT outage, it is treated as an IT P1 and receives a response within 30 minutes [S1].

questions.question: How long are laptop backups kept?
questions.answer: Laptop backups are kept for 90 days [S1].

questions.question: How far in advance must flights be booked?
questions.answer: Flights must be booked at least 14 days before departure [S1].

questions.question: When am I allowed to fly business class?
questions.answer: Business class is allowed only for flights longer than 8 hours [S1].

questions.question: What is the daily allowance for international trips?
questions.answer: The daily allowance for international travel is USD 75 [S1].

questions.question: What is the hotel limit per night in metro cities?
questions.answer: Hotel costs are capped at INR 7,000 per night in metro cities [S1].

questions.question: How many days before an international trip is manager approval needed?
questions.answer: Manager approval for international trips is needed at least 21 days before departure [S1].

questions.question: Who arranges travel insurance for international trips?
questions.answer: The HR team arranges travel insurance for international trips [S1].
